builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-21, for the girls soccer build: commitment lists (TopDrawerSoccer, SoccerWire, PrepSoccer), college athletics sites' news feeds, school and local papers, the clubs' commitment pages and the players' own SportsRecruits pages. Every quote checked against its page as served (or rendered, where the page is drawn by script) by the pass and again at assembly. A further round on 2026-11-25 over all four builds (README and DATA-SOURCES §1.15).
notes: Players on the tracked girls varsity soccer rosters a public page says have committed to, or signed with, a college team, in soccer or any other sport. The rules are field hockey's (README, "College commitments"): the page names the player, the college and the sport, and either names her high school or gives the roster's class year with a hometown in the school's own area (a row with no grade needs the school, with one exception below); offers, interests, visits and camps are not commitments; a social-media post counts only from an official college, school or club account (none is cited here).

22 commitments: 19 soccer, 1 field hockey, 1 softball, 1 track and field; 1 signed; 9 high, 13 medium (counted 2026-11-25). Allison Park's (Illinois) is signed: the college's own signing release names her with her high school. Isabella Cain's row on Los Gatos' roster has no grade: her sources (TopDrawerSoccer) give class of 2028 and Los Gatos as her hometown but name no school, so her commitment is medium confidence. Kat Smith's is a field hockey commitment (Ithaca), on her soccer roster row.

Read: TopDrawerSoccer's California girls commitment search for 2027 (225) and 2028 (128) and its player profiles, SoccerWire's commitment tracker (2027 and 2028), PrepSoccer's California list and 1,704 posts since 2025-11-01, 1,043 college athletics sites' news feeds (NCAA Division I, II and III women's soccer members and 19 NAIA; 6,237 stories opened, 3,236 dated 2026-11-11 or later), 12 student papers and 8 local papers, the clubs' commitment pages (MVLA, De Anza Force, SVSA, Bay Area Surf, Valley Surf, Los Gatos United), and the players' own SportsRecruits pages ("Committed to …", dated by the entry on the profile). Every quote was read twice by the pass and re-read at assembly by a separate script on 2026-11-21.

Recall is partial: no name-by-name search of every senior, junior or ungraded row; no student paper was found for 20 of the schools; the San Mateo Daily Journal, the Los Altos Town Crier and the Half Moon Bay Review were not read; 96 college sites gave no feed; community-college sites were not retried; MVLA's and SF Elite's commitment widgets are drawn by script. Leads left out because no page meets the rule: four players named with a college but no school, hometown or agreeing class year (a Mercy Burlingame, a Soquel and two Valley Christian players).

Removed 2026-11-25: Zuri Brandt's (Mitty) commitment to Washington, and Washington's college record with it. MaxPreps' Mitty roster of 2026-11-24 no longer lists Zuri Brandt (#20, grade 12) or Scarlett Martinez (#4, grade 11): 26 players on 2026-11-21, 24 on 2026-11-24, no other change. Hudl's 2026 Mitty varsity roster, read 2026-11-25, still lists both. The site shows only players on the MaxPreps rosters, so the record had been left out as roster drift; the owner decided to drop it (git history keeps it).

On 2026-11-25 a commitment round over all four builds (field hockey, volleyball, soccer, basketball), every row as it stood that day, varsity and JV, by the same rules; docs/DATA-SOURCES.md §1.15 says what it read and did not. It added ten. Caelyn Dyer (William & Mary) and Jasmine Vemuri (Whitman), Notre Dame San Jose, whose roster was posted after the 2026-11-21 round: PrepSoccer's player pages name the school (high). Alina Decker (Menlo-Atherton, listed by MaxPreps as 'Decker Alina') to Brandeis in track and field, from the M-A Chronicle (medium, for the swapped name). Seven on the owner's ruling of 2026-11-25 that a page that ties a commitment to the player through her club alone (the club's own announcement, or a list or profile naming the club and not the school) counts when the row is already tied to that club in clubs.json; the Monterey Surf and MVLA pages cited are the clubs' own announcements, shown on their own sites from their own accounts (all medium, the basis of each naming the tie): Rebecca Iffla, Audrey Pfeiffer, Kenzie Willerer and Kaitlyn Gray, the leads left out on 2026-11-21, and Bailey Portillo, Samantha Torres and Sherlyn Farfan, from Monterey Surf's own page, tied once Monterey Surf's N1 rosters were kept the same day. New sources: the M-A Chronicle for Juliana Pandolfo (dated Nov 9), TopDrawerSoccer's roundups of Nov 16 and 23 for Kailani Bock and Delaney Kumer. Leads left out: three Saint Francis and one Menlo-Atherton signee and others named in college releases whose schools' rosters do not list them (Saint Francis' roster is empty).
